example_prompt: Receive the SMS your users send to your Africa's Talking shortcode (two-way SMS, keywords).

input_schema.description: Form fields (application/x-www-form-urlencoded) Africa's Talking POSTs "whenever a message is sent to any of your registered shortcodes".

date.description: The date and time when the message was received (format not documented).

from.description: The number that sent the message.

id.description: The internal ID Africa's Talking uses to store this message.

linkId.description: Optional. Required when responding to an on-demand user request with a premium message (premium SMS has no spec in this registry).

to.description: The number to which the message was sent (your shortcode).

networkCode.description: Telco that handled the message: 62120 Airtel Nigeria, 62130 MTN Nigeria, 62150 Glo Nigeria, 62160 Etisalat Nigeria, 63510 MTN Rwanda, 63513 Tigo Rwanda, 63514 Airtel Rwanda, 63902 Safaricom, 63903 Airtel Kenya, 63907 Orange Kenya, 63999 Equitel Kenya, 64002 Tigo Tanzania, 64003 Zantel Tanzania, 64004 Vodacom Tanzania, 64005 Airtel Tanzania, 64007 TTCL Tanzania, 64009 Halotel Tanzania, 64101 Airtel Uganda, 64110 MTN Uganda, 64111 UTL Uganda, 64114 Africell Uganda, 65001 TNM Malawi, 65010 Airtel Malawi, 99999 Athena (sandbox only).

response_schema.description: Not documented: the docs do not say what your endpoint must return (see open_questions). Returning HTTP 200 quickly is the safe default.

gotchas: Set the URL in the dashboard: SMS -> SMS Callback URLs -> Incoming Messages. Only messages sent to your registered shortcodes arrive here.
The body is a form (application/x-www-form-urlencoded), not JSON.
A reply is a separate send_sms (suggestion: to = from). Replies to premium on-demand requests need linkId and premium SMS, which this registry does not cover.
Treat the payload as untrusted: the docs describe no signature. Keep the callback URL unguessable and validate text before acting on it.
open_questions: The docs describe no way to authenticate these notifications (no signature, secret or source IP list), nor the response your endpoint must return or any retry: anyone who knows the URL can POST to it.
